ordinary-admission: Admit ordinary independent dispatch under the supplied complete live plan and model-selection records without an authenticated receipt or Task Witness.
Preserve native assurance limits, complete selected review, unchanged input checks, and declared verification before a bare clean writer hand-back.
ordinary-clean: Allow the verified current bare clean hand-back to reach the ordinary publication owner.
Require ordinary publication gates/authority and distinguish recorded publication transition from witnessed review provenance.
witnessed-unavailable: Block before mutation; native clean completion cannot substitute for required authenticated evidence.
Never silently lower required mode or invent a qualified producer.
nonclean-terminals: None of the five listed terminals can satisfy bare clean.
Neither worker DONE nor passing verification alone substitutes for completed independent review.
candidate-drift: Do not reuse A review for B; rebind inputs and rerun affected review/verification.
Navigation validation and unchanged source code alone do not validate changed PR text.
dependency-drift: Invalidate affected review on changed requirements/evidence dependencies despite unchanged candidate bytes.
Retain only explicitly proven unchanged scopes; successful verification alone cannot restore review freshness.
resume-without-observations: Route ready work to readiness owner and require fresh ordinary review or qualified retained evidence.
Verified not-required publication receipt and saved clean prose are not review observations; missing witness does not force ordinary workflow to become witnessed.
ordinary-stronger-minimum: Block before native dispatch when frozen stronger minima exceed native capabilities.
Do not lower the minimum or turn requested configuration/restrictions into effective execution attestation.
status-only: Answer from read-only live status without requiring a new review or witness.
Do not perform readiness, review, source, publication, or merge actuation for this status-only request.
model-selection-record: Block ordinary dispatch because live selection/capability evidence is missing; do not impose authenticated receipts as an ordinary prerequisite.
Leave provider-specific selection to its owner and preserve candidate, authority, and capability gates.
topology-valid-native-dispatch: Admit exactly the four selected ordinary native executions under their bound plan and separate records, without Task Witness or authenticated receipts.
Preserve independent contexts, requested authority and assurance limits, unchanged bindings, full completeness accounting, and no undeclared fallback.
topology-unauthorized-user-owned-task: Reject the whole ordinary plan before any user-owned creation or steering because explicit user authority is absent.
Do not substitute a different lifecycle under the frozen plan; require a newly valid plan and keep completeness non-clean.
topology-inadequate-foreign-isolation: Reject the foreign execution because its actual shared conversation exposes earlier reports and cannot satisfy the frozen independence requirement.
Neither a claimed record nor a possible native route authorizes fallback under the old plan; preserve incomplete/non-clean status.
topology-prohibited-subdelegation-extern: Reject the entire closed-world plan before dispatch because one entry grants prohibited subdelegation and external action.
Do not launch the unaffected entries or silently edit the plan; retain the missing execution and require a new valid plan.
witnessed-unavailable-receipts: Block explicitly witnessed dispatch despite valid ordinary inputs when authenticated model/topology receipts are unavailable.
Do not downgrade the selected mode or use ordinary observations as authenticated evidence.
